ex.en: Her anxiety manifested itself in constant headaches and poor sleep.
ex.zh: 她的焦虑表现为持续头痛和睡眠不佳。

words.note: manifest 作动词常与 itself 连用，表“显现”。

ex.en: To be blunt, your report needs a lot more work.
ex.zh: 直说吧，你的报告还需要多加修改。

words.note: blunt 指刀钝或说话直率；blunt the edge 指使变钝。

ex.en: We endeavor to answer every email within two working days.
ex.zh: 我们努力在两个工作日内回复每封邮件。

words.note: endeavor 后可接 to do；make every endeavor 表尽力。

ex.en: The medicine relieved her headache within twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 这药二十分钟内就缓解了她的头痛。

words.note: relieve 常接 pain、stress 等；名词是 relief。

ex.en: The shop sells elegant quartz watches at reasonable prices.
ex.zh: 这家店以合理的价格出售精致的石英表。

words.note: quartz 不可数，石英表常说 quartz watch。

ex.en: The office air-conditioning broke down during the hottest week.
ex.zh: 办公室的空调在最热的那一周坏了。

words.note: air-conditioning 也可写作 air conditioner。

ex.en: Our hotel is adjacent to the train station and a mall.
ex.zh: 我们酒店紧邻火车站和一家商场。

words.note: adjacent 后接介词 to，表“与…相邻”。

ex.en: Many graduates are still looking for full-time employment.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生仍在寻找全职工作。

words.note: employment 不可数，找工作说 find employment，不用冠词。

ex.en: The city has invested heavily in public transport this year.
ex.zh: 这座城市今年在公共交通上投入巨大。

words.note: public transport 为英式说法，美式常用 transportation。

ex.en: Please be specific about the date and time of the meeting.
ex.zh: 请具体说明会议的时间和日期。

words.note: specific 后接 about 表讲清细节；反义词是 general。

ex.en: The teacher drew an analogy between the heart and a pump.
ex.zh: 老师把心脏比作一台水泵。

words.note: analogy 常用 draw an analogy between A and B。

ex.en: You must submit your application before the end of March.
ex.zh: 你必须在三月底前提交申请。

words.note: application 指申请或应用，动词形式是 apply。

ex.en: A short break can make the rest of the day more productive.
ex.zh: 短暂休息能让一天余下的时间更高效。

words.note: productive 指有成效；名词 productivity 指生产率。

ex.en: Gardeners prune the trees every winter to keep them healthy.
ex.zh: 园丁每年冬天修剪树木以保持其健康。

words.note: prune 本指修剪枝条，也表示削减开支、删减内容。

ex.en: Students are encouraged to engage in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 学校鼓励学生参与课堂讨论。

words.note: engage in 表从事某事；be engaged to sb 指与某人订婚。

ex.en: Her story struck a chord with many young readers.
ex.zh: 她的故事引起了许多年轻读者的共鸣。

words.note: strike a chord (with) 表引起共鸣，注意别与 cord 混。

ex.en: She is taking five courses this semester and working part-time.
ex.zh: 这学期她选了五门课，还做兼职。

words.note: semester 指两学期制的学期；三学期制用 term 更常见。

ex.en: The company adopted a new marketing strategy last spring.
ex.zh: 公司去年春天采取了新的营销策略。

words.note: strategy 可数，采取策略用 adopt/work out a strategy。

ex.en: He spent the remainder of the year working on his thesis.
ex.zh: 他用那年余下的时间写论文。

words.note: remainder 常与 of 连用，指剩余部分，不加 s。

ex.en: The team designed an experiment to test their hypothesis.
ex.zh: 团队设计了一个实验来检验他们的假设。

words.note: hypothesis 复数为 hypotheses，常接 test。

ex.en: The moon revolves around the earth about once a month.
ex.zh: 月球大约每月绕地球转一周。

words.note: revolve around 也引申为“以…为中心”，如生活围绕家庭。

ex.en: The old bridge collapsed during the heavy storm last night.
ex.zh: 这座旧桥昨晚在暴风雨中坍塌了。

words.note: collapse 指建筑物倒塌或体系崩溃，也可指人昏倒。

ex.en: The two countries have argued over this territory for decades.
ex.zh: 两国为这片领土争论了数十年。

words.note: territory 指领土或知识领域，如 familiar territory。

ex.en: She summoned the courage to speak in front of the class.
ex.zh: 她鼓起勇气在全班面前发言。

words.note: summon 后常接 courage、meeting、witness 等。

ex.en: The argument flared up again after dinner that evening.
ex.zh: 那天晚饭后，争吵又爆发了。

words.note: flare up 指疾病、冲突突然加剧，也可说 tempers flare。

ex.en: The map gives an accurate picture of the coastal roads.
ex.zh: 这幅地图准确描绘了沿海公路。

words.note: accurate 侧重准确无误；名词 accuracy，副词 accurately。

ex.en: According to legend, the lake was created by a giant.
ex.zh: 据传说，这个湖是一个巨人所造。

words.note: legend 可指传说或传奇人物；legendary 意为“传奇的”。

ex.en: It is hard to maintain a balance between work and family.
ex.zh: 在工作和家庭之间保持平衡很难。

words.note: maintain 可接宾语或 that 从句，表“坚持认为”。

ex.en: The project needs someone with technical expertise in data security.
ex.zh: 该项目需要一位具备数据安全技术专长的人。

words.note: expertise 不可数，常用 expertise in 某领域。

ex.en: At that price, the used bike was a real bargain.
ex.zh: 以那个价格买这辆旧自行车真划算。

words.note: bargain 可指便宜货或协议，讨价还价说 bargain over。
